hero.title: Painting and renovations
hero.lead: A one-stop shop for renovating services to businesses and homes since 2002. We offer an end-to-end solution to transform your business premises or home environment.
hero.alt: Restored bay window with stained glass and a painted window seat

intro.title: Why choose us
paragraphs: Our skilled construction team provides a bespoke professional service that has been revamping commercial and residential properties for decades.
Our master craftsmen have worked on many of Ireland's best known buildings, including hospitals, schools, government buildings and offices. We use environmentally friendly paint.
facts: Member of the National Guild of Master Craftsmen

items.title: Residential painting
items.text: Give your home a fresh, vibrant look. Whether you're restoring historical woodwork or adding a new splash of colour, we're here to help.

items.title: Residential renovations
items.text: Transform your property into a stylish, modern and comfortable living space. We handle your entire renovation journey, from our first meeting to the final handover.

items.title: Commercial painting
items.text: A team of master craftsmen with experience on hospitals, schools, government buildings and offices.

items.title: Commercial renovations
items.text: A fresh new look for your working environment, office space or shop, with simple yet innovative commercial and industrial finishes.

items.title: Property maintenance
items.text: Maintenance, repairs and painting for property management companies, estate agents and private companies who own or manage commercial and residential property.
